# netbox_inventory_item_role (Data Source)

Retrieves a single inventory item role from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_inventory_item_role" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "inventory_item_role_id" {
  value = data.netbox_inventory_item_role.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the inventory item role.
- `name` (String) The name of the inventory item role.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the inventory item role.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the inventory item role.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the inventory item role.
- `created` (String) When the inventory item role was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the inventory item role, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the inventory item role.
- `inventoryitem_count` (Number) The number of inventoryitem of the inventory item role.
- `last_updated` (String) When the inventory item role was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the inventory item role.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
